q: tell me about simone de beauvoir
what is simone de beauvoir and how does it work
tell me about the history of simone de beauvoir
how does simone de beauvoir work
a: Simone Lucie Ernestine Marie Bertrand de Beauvoir was a French existentialist philosopher, writer, social theorist, and feminist activist. Though she did not consider herself a philosopher, nor was she considered one at the time of her death, she had a significant influence on both feminist existentialism and feminist theory.
